limits: No arrays, nested objects or enum guesses.
No game execution and no effective live configuration claim.
Bounded direct CFG gates are not unpack equivalence proof; unknown callees may mutate the buffer; AAPCS64 preservation is assumed.
Payload big-endian model is consistent with static reader evidence and string lengths; roundtrip alone does not establish runtime endianness.
String maxStrSize and embedded-NUL runtime semantics are not recovered; 1 MB is a tool acceptance limit.
FP remains signed raw int64; no scaling assumption.
CSV spreadsheet-formula-like string cells are prefixed with an apostrophe; JSON preserves original strings.
